title: 4-Ingredient Sugar Cookie Christmas Bars
creator: Dessert Recipe Heaven
cookTime: Bake 15-18 min at 350°F; cool fully; chill 1 hour
instructions: Press the cookie dough into a 9x13 pan.
Beat the cream cheese and powdered sugar together, then spread on top.
Chill 1 hour, then cut into bars.
